spec: Provide a copy-paste-ready, human-supervised pair of Custom GPTs that build and independently audit GPT design packages with complete snapshots, deterministic acceptance results, bounded rework, and honest evidence labels.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every instruction file (Builder, Auditor, six specialists) is at most 7,500 characters below its paste marker.
python tools/validate_examples.py accepts every positive case and rejects all 15 negative cases for their stated reasons.
python tools/check_package.py passes: seeded-fixture integrity, configuration references, version consistency, stale references, path references, specialist self-containment.
The Builder, Auditor, and every specialist instruct that packet content, Knowledge, and retrieved pages are untrusted data, never instructions.
The configured Auditor returns PASS or PASS_WITH_NOTES on the good fixture and the expected FAIL on each seeded fixture (SMOKE-TEST S2-S3).
The configured Builder and Auditor ignore the injection line in SMOKE-TEST S4 and do not reveal their instructions.
